what: Pressing an item of the floating center pill menu brings down a sub panel stacked in the same place like a curtain — the panel comes from -100% above and the panel interior from 100% below, meeting at 1s expo.inOut into place (so the text does not slide with the panel but is revealed within the window), the pill row goes off in .7s, and after .3s the items in the panel rise from 60px below with a .05s stagger over .7s power3.out. Closing (× or Esc): items drop 50px from the bottom up and go off in .7s power2.in, the panel retracts upward after .1s, and at .6s the pill row returns over 1s

options.dur: Duration of the curtain coming down and clearing (seconds), default 1 — .5 for frequently opened apps
options.each: Duration (s) for items to appear and disappear, default .7 (also the length for the pill row to fade out)
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Sub-panel (required, paired with a cell via data-key) — the inner part where the first child slides the opposite way
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Items that appear in sequence inside the panel (title · list rows)

use:
Menu 1
Sub 1
note: On phone width the original also switches directly inside the drawer without this curtain — on phones the user should remove data-fx or set dur: 0
